title: CKS Toast Rack Chrome
text: CKS Toast Rack Chrome. So... I purchased this toast rack and one that is fine china.  This one works for holding the toast in the oven, warming... as you have in on a pan or some foil.... but it's not so great at "holding" the toast.... the toast sort of slips out. In comparison....the one made of china... and it works so much better as it has a tray underneath. This toast rack is about 7 to 8" long... holds 7 pieces of toast.  I think you could put a bagel in if you wished as the rungs are wide enough.  Thinner pieces of toast are really not suited as they slip through and out. As I said, I use this one in the oven to keep the toast warm... and the rack works in keeping the toast crispy and not soggy.  I will update if any new info would be useful.

product_metadata.title: Kilo Victorian Design Chrome 6 Slice Toast Rack with Ball Feet and Loop Carry Handle
features: This classic toast rack is the ideal piece of tableware for the breakfast table, holds 6 pieces of hot crisp toast, ready for serving.
Specially designed 6 slot horseshoe shape bread holder is perfect for keeping the toast crisp and preventing it from going soggy.
Very sturdy and hard-wearing construction which also adds an elegant and stylish touch to the table. Wipe clean, chrome finish.
Ergonomic handle for easy carrying the cooked toast from the toaster to the family breakfast dining table.
High quality shiny chrome, easy to clean and dishwasher safe, store near toaster ready for using.
description: The Kilo classic Victorian design toast rack is the ideal for breakfast holding crisp cooked toast ready for serving. This has a specially designed 6 slot horseshoe shaped bread holder to keep toast crisp and not soggy. The very sturdy robust and hard-wearing construction of the metal is also elegant and stylish. Ergonomic loop handle for easy carrying the cooked toast from the toaster to the table. Great for breakfast, lunch, tea, dinner parties and many catering occasions. High quality chrome is easy to clean. The Victorian toast rack is easy to clean and dishwasher safe. Dimensions: 15cm. Kilo by CKS offers contemporary and innovative functional kitchen tools made from tough, high quality materials that will stand the test of time, providing unrivalled performance in any kitchen environment.
